const patch="*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboPaint 月 trajectory and calibration record.
+
+Run a phase explicitly, e.g. ``python gen.py dip``.  This file keeps the
+world/paper coordinate conversion and all executed trajectories together.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+ROOT = Path("/app/output")
+PAPER_Z = 0.0202
+Q_DOWN = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0])
+MM_PER_PX = 227.185 / 1024.0
+
+
+def pixel_world(u, v, z):
+    return np.array([0.1 + (512 - v) * MM_PER_PX / 1000,
+                     (512 - u) * MM_PER_PX / 1000, z], dtype=float)
+
+
+def now_pose(res):
+    return np.asarray(res.meta["proprio"]["now"][7:14], dtype=float)
+
+
+def save_result(res, name):
+    d = ROOT / name
+    d.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    (d / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
+    for cam, im in res.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(im).save(d / f"{cam}.png")
+    if res.proprio is not None:
+        np.save(d / "proprio.npy", res.proprio)
+    if res.frames:
+        for cam, frames in res.frames.items():
+            np.save(d / f"{cam}_frames.npy", frames)
+
+
+def move(r, xyz, speed=0.04, hold=12, name="move", cameras=None, video="none"):
+    """Stream closely spaced Cartesian targets and settle at the endpoint."""
+    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=["side_cam"])
+    start = now_pose(obs)[:3]
+    xyz = np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float)
+    n = max(2, int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(xyz - start) / speed / 0.05)))
+    points = np.linspace(start, xyz, n)
+    if hold:
+        points = np.vstack([points, np.tile(xyz, (hold, 1))])
+    actions = np.column_stack([points, np.tile(Q_DOWN, (len(points), 1))])
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", actions, dt=0.05,
+                   cameras=cameras or ["canvas_cam", "practice_cam", "scene_cam", "side_cam"],
+                   video=video, note=name)
+    save_result(res, name)
+    print(name, "start", start, "target", xyz, "actual", now_pose(res)[:3],
+          "plan", res.meta.get("plan"), "steps", res.meta.get("control_steps_chunk"),
+          "time left", res.meta.get("time_left_s"), flush=True)
+    return res
+
+
+def main():
+    r = Robot()
+    phase = sys.argv[1]
+    if phase == "dip":
+        move(r, [0.0, 0.1856, 0.065], name="dip_approach")
+        move(r, [0.0, 0.1856, 0.012], speed=0.015, hold=15, name="dip_contact")
+        move(r, [0.0, 0.1856, 0.075], speed=0.025, name="dip_lift")
+    elif phase == "practice":
+        move(r, [0.07, -0.1856, 0.075], name="practice_approach")
+        move(r, [0.07, -0.1856, PAPER_Z - 0.003], speed=0.015,
+             hold=15, name="practice_contact")
+        move(r, [0.13, -0.1856, PAPER_Z - 0.003], speed=0.025,
+             hold=15, name="practice_line")
+        move(r, [0.13, -0.1856, 0.075], speed=0.025,
+             name="practice_lift")
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(phase)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch))
